from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw, rdMolDescriptors

# Atom key: (element, name). We'll add in order and keep index map.
atoms = [
 ('C','a1'),   # 0 ringA alkene C (bears Me m1)
 ('C','a2'),   # 1 ringA alkene CH (apex)
 ('C','A'),    # 2 upper bridgehead (bears Me mA, dashed)
 ('C','B'),    # 3 lower bridgehead (bears OH oB)
 ('C','a5'),   # 4 ringA CH (bears OH o5)
 ('C','m1'),   # 5 Me on a1
 ('C','mA'),   # 6 Me on A (dashed)
 ('O','oB'),   # 7 OH on B
 ('O','o5'),   # 8 OH on a5
 ('C','n1'),   # 9 CH2 top of ringB
 ('C','P'),    # 10 cyclopropane fusion (top)
 ('C','T2'),   # 11 cyclopropane fusion (lower)
 ('C','CG'),   # 12 cyclopropane C(Me)2
 ('C','g1'),   # 13 gem-Me
 ('C','g2'),   # 14 gem-Me
 ('C','Hc'),   # 15 CH (bears H, right)
 ('C','K'),    # 16 carbonyl C
 ('O','oK'),   # 17 carbonyl O
 ('C','Q'),    # 18 alkene CH (ringC)
 ('C','R'),    # 19 alkene C (bears CH2OH)
 ('C','M'),    # 20 CH(OH) ringC
 ('O','oM'),   # 21 OH on M
 ('C','cW'),   # 22 CH2 of hydroxymethyl
 ('O','oW'),   # 23 OH of hydroxymethyl
]
bonds = [
 # ring A cyclopentene
 ('a1','a2',2),('a2','A',1),('A','B',1),('B','a5',1),('a5','a1',1),
 ('a1','m1',1),('A','mA',1),('B','oB',1),('a5','o5',1),
 # ring B (cycloheptanone) fused to A along A-B
 ('A','n1',1),('n1','P',1),('P','T2',1),('T2','Hc',1),('Hc','K',1),('K','B',1),
 ('K','oK',2),
 # cyclopropane
 ('P','CG',1),('CG','T2',1),('CG','g1',1),('CG','g2',1),
 # ring C: Hc-Q=R-M-?  and CH2OH on R
 ('Hc','Q',1),('Q','R',2),('R','M',1),('M','oM',1),('R','cW',1),('cW','oW',1),
 # close ring C: M back to B (lower bridgehead)
 ('M','B',1),
]
name2i = {n:i for i,(e,n) in enumerate(atoms)}
rw = Chem.RWMol()
for e,n in atoms:
    rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))
for a,b,o in bonds:
    rw.AddBond(name2i[a],name2i[b], Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m = rw.GetMol()
# report degrees and valence issues
for e,n in atoms:
    a = m.GetAtomWithIdx(name2i[n])
    print(f"{n:3s} {e} deg={a.GetDegree()} totalVal={a.GetTotalValence()} Hs={a.GetTotalNumHs()}")
try:
    Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
    print('SANITIZE OK', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
except Exception as ex:
    print('SANITIZE FAIL', ex)
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Draw, rdMolDescriptors
# Tigliane skeleton via ring assembly
# ringA: a1 a2 A B a5 ; ringB shares A-B ; ringC shares b2-b3 ; cyclopropane shares c2-c3
atoms = {}
def add(e,n):
    atoms[n]=e
# framework
for n in ['a1','a2','A','B','a5']: add('C',n)
for n in ['b1','b2','b3','b4','b5']: add('C',n)
for n in ['c1','c2','c3','c4']: add('C',n)
add('C','d1')  # cyclopropane apex (gem-dimethyl)
bonds=[]
def b(x,y,o=1): bonds.append((x,y,o))
# ring A (cyclopentene a1=a2)
b('a1','a2',2); b('a2','A'); b('A','B'); b('B','a5'); b('a5','a1')
# ring B (cycloheptane) shares A-B: A-b1-b2-b3-b4-b5-B-A
b('A','b1'); b('b1','b2'); b('b2','b3'); b('b3','b4'); b('b4','b5'); b('b5','B')
# ring C (cyclohexane) shares b2-b3: b2-b3-c1-c2-c3-c4-b2
b('b3','c1'); b('c1','c2'); b('c2','c3'); b('c3','c4'); b('c4','b2')
# cyclopropane shares c2-c3
b('c2','d1'); b('d1','c3')
# substituents
add('C','mA'); b('A','mA')        # Me on upper bridgehead A (dashed)
add('O','oB'); b('B','oB')        # OH on lower bridgehead B
add('O','o5'); b('a5','o5')       # OH on a5
add('C','m1'); b('a1','m1')       # Me on alkene a1
add('C','g1'); b('d1','g1'); add('C','g2'); b('d1','g2')  # gem-dimethyl
# carbonyl on ring B at b5 (near B)
add('O','oK'); b('b5','oK',2)
# ring C double bond c1=c2, hydroxymethyl on c2, OH on c3? 
bonds = [(x,y,(2 if (x=='c1' and y=='c2') else o)) for (x,y,o) in bonds]
add('C','cW'); b('c2','cW'); add('O','oW'); b('cW','oW')  # CH2OH on c2
add('O','oC'); b('c4','oC')       # OH on ring C (c4)
# 6,8-dimethyl: need 2 more Me (we have mA on A, m1 on a1 =2; phorbol has 4 Me total: 2 gem + mA + m1 =4). good, 4 Me.
name2i = {n:i for i,(n,e) in enumerate(atoms.items())}
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for n,e in atoms.items(): rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))
for x,y,o in bonds: rw.AddBond(name2i[x],name2i[y], Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol(); m.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
over=[n for n,e in atoms.items() if e=='C' and m.GetAtomWithIdx(name2i[n]).GetDegree()>4]
print('overvalent:',over)
try:
    Chem.SanitizeMol(m); print('OK', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
    Chem.rdDepictor.Compute2DCoords(m); Draw.MolToFile(m,'tig.png',size=(760,640))
except Exception as ex: print('FAIL', str(ex)[:300])
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
atoms = ['a1','a2','A','B','a5','m1','mA','oB','o5',
         'n1','P','T2','CG','g1','g2','Hc','K','oK',
         'Q','R','M','oM','cX','cW','oW']
elem = {n:('O' if n.startswith('o') else 'C') for n in atoms}
bonds = [
 ('a1','a2',2),('a2','A',1),('A','B',1),('B','a5',1),('a5','a1',1),
 ('a1','m1',1),('A','mA',1),('B','oB',1),('a5','o5',1),
 ('A','n1',1),('n1','P',1),('P','T2',1),('T2','Hc',1),('Hc','K',1),('K','B',1),('K','oK',2),
 ('P','CG',1),('CG','T2',1),('CG','g1',1),('CG','g2',1),
 ('Hc','Q',1),('Q','R',2),('R','M',1),('M','cX',1),('cX','T2',1),
 ('R','cW',1),('cW','oW',1),('M','oM',1),
]
name2i={n:i for i,n in enumerate(atoms)}
# stereocenters and target face for a key substituent (+1 front, -1 back)
# key substituent per center
targets = {'A':('mA',-1),'B':('oB',+1),'a5':('o5',+1),'Hc':('H_Hc',+1),'M':('oM',+1),'P':('CG',+1),'T2':('CG',+1)}
def build():
    rw=Chem.RWMol()
    for n in atoms: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(elem[n]))
    for x,y,o in bonds: rw.AddBond(name2i[x],name2i[y], Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
    m=rw.GetMol(); m.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
    return m

def embed_with_tags(tags):
    m=build()
    for c,t in tags.items():
        m.GetAtomWithIdx(name2i[c]).SetChiralTag(t)
    m=Chem.AddHs(m)
    p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=7; p.useChirality=True
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1500)
    return m

def faces(m):
    conf=m.GetConformer()
    ring_idx=[name2i[n] for n in ['A','B','a5','Hc','T2','P','K','n1']]
    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); nrm=vt[2]
    # find H on Hc
    hHc=None
    hc=m.GetAtomWithIdx(name2i['Hc'])
    for nb in hc.GetNeighbors():
        if nb.GetAtomicNum()==1: hHc=nb.GetIdx()
    def pos(i): return np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))
    def side(atom):
        if atom=='H_Hc': i=hHc
        else: i=name2i[atom]
        return float(np.dot(pos(i)-cen,nrm))
    d={a:side(a) for a in ['o5','oB','oM','H_Hc','CG','mA','g1','g2']}
    # orient: make oB positive
    if d['oB']<0: nrm=-nrm; d={a:side(a) for a in d}
    return d,nrm

CW=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW
CCW=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW
tags={c:CW for c in targets}
for it in range(8):
    m=embed_with_tags(tags)
    d,nrm=faces(m)
    bad=[]
    for c,(sub,tgt) in targets.items():
        if sub=='H_Hc':
            # check H side
            pass
        val=d[sub]
        if (val*tgt)<0: bad.append(c)
    print('iter',it,'faces',{k:round(v,2) for k,v in d.items()},'bad',bad)
    if not bad:
        print('CONVERGED')
        break
    for c in bad:
        tags[c]=CCW if tags[c]==CW else CW
# save best
conf=m.GetConformer()
import os
def write_xyz(mol, path):
    conf=mol.GetConformer()
    n=mol.GetNumAtoms()
    lines=[str(n),'tigliane C20H28O5']
    for i in range(n):
        a=mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i); p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        lines.append(f"{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x:12.6f} {p.y:12.6f} {p.z:12.6f}")
    open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
write_xyz(m,'answer_draft.xyz')
print('heavy atoms', sum(1 for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()>1), 'total atoms', m.GetNumAtoms())
EOF

 ('a1','m1',1),('A','mA',1),('B','oB',1),('a5','o5',1),
 ('A','n1',1),('n1','P',1),('P','T2',1),('T2','Hc',1),('Hc','K',1),('K','B',1),('K','oK',2),
 ('P','CG',1),('CG','T2',1),('CG','g1',1),('CG','g2',1),
 ('Hc','Q',1),('Q','R',2),('R','M',1),('M','cX',1),('cX','T2',1),
 ('R','cW',1),('cW','oW',1),('M','oM',1),
]
name2i={n:i for i,n in enumerate(atoms)}
def build():
    rw=Chem.RWMol()
    for n in atoms: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(elem[n]))
    for x,y,o in bonds: rw.AddBond(name2i[x],name2i[y], Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)

from rdkit import Chem
import numpy as np
m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile('answer_draft.xyz')
conf=m.GetConformer()
# name->idx: need to rebuild mapping; xyz has no names. Rebuild from order.
atoms = ['a1','a2','A','B','a5','m1','mA','oB','o5',
         'n1','P','T2','CG','g1','g2','Hc','K','oK',
         'Q','R','M','oM','cX','cW','oW']
# heavy atoms in xyz are in order of AddHs: original atoms first (heavy), then Hs.
# RDKit AddHs appends Hs after heavy atoms, preserving heavy order.
name2i={n:i for i,n in enumerate(atoms)}
def pos(n): 
    i=name2i[n]; p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); return np.array([p.x,p.y,p.z])
# plane through carbinol carbons a5,B,M
p1,p2,p3=pos('a5'),pos('B'),pos('M')
nrm=np.cross(p2-p1,p3-p1); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
for o in ['o5','oB','oM','Hc','CG','mA','cW','g1','g2']:
    v=pos(o)-p1
